brew.outdated-all: HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 brew outdated --verbose | awk '{n=$1; sub(/.*[/]/, "", n); v=$NF; gsub(/[()]/, "", v); print n, v}'

brew-cask.outdated-all: HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 brew outdated --cask --verbose | awk '{n=$1; sub(/.*[/]/, "", n); v=$NF; gsub(/[()]/, "", v); print n, v}'

dnf.outdated-all: dnf -q --cacheonly check-update | awk 'NF>=3 && $2 ~ /^[0-9]/ {name=$1; sub(/[.][^.]*$/, "", name); print name, $2}'

dnf-copr.install: sudo dnf copr enable -y {copr} && sudo dnf install -y {pkg}
dnf-copr.outdated-all: dnf -q --cacheonly check-update | awk 'NF>=3 && $2 ~ /^[0-9]/ {name=$1; sub(/[.][^.]*$/, "", name); print name, $2}'

dnf-repo.outdated-all: dnf -q --cacheonly check-update | awk 'NF>=3 && $2 ~ /^[0-9]/ {name=$1; sub(/[.][^.]*$/, "", name); print name, $2}'
